page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "fuisse", "dedisset", "Rosarum", "Mareschalli"). Converted consonantal i/j and vowel j per the u/v, i/j rule: "Junij", "jacruentum", "juventutis", "cuius". "secundam" is read from a letter that could be f or long s; treated as long s. The word "copia-" ends the page, its continuation is on the next page. No catchword or signature is printed.
